title: Public repo cleanup and final QA
context: Repo will be submitted as a public GitHub URL per the application form requirements.
objective: Make the repo submission-ready: no secrets, clear license, working .env.example, clean commit history.
scope_in: Secret-scan the full repo and git history, remove/rotate anything found
Add LICENSE (MIT, per your usual default unless you want otherwise)
.env.example lists every required var with placeholder values, no real keys
Run the work-review skill against the finished build for a final gap check
acceptance_criteria: Secret scan (e.g. git-secrets or manual grep for key patterns) returns clean
A fresh clone of the repo, following only the README, boots successfully
work-review pass completed, any flagged gaps addressed or consciously accepted
